references.observed: Regulator gives a 2250 m crest and an 86 m maximum height. The continuous mapped crest road is 2103.66 m between the selected tag endpoints.
Basin authority lists a 386 m crest, 380.31 m normal maximum water, 372 m normal minimum and 367 m extraordinary minimum. The right-bank spillway has four radial gates and the plant has six units.
Aerial photograph shows the intake platform and walkway, rockfill slopes, the continuous powerhouse windows and three white roof portal frames.
Close photo shows a concrete crest bridge above steel radial gates, curved dividers and a dry sloped discharge chute.
Retained dam area locates its bent crest and sloping embankment and distinguishes the powerhouse and spillway.
